Class CargoUnloadMessage

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.galaxy_trucker.common.messages.flight.cardActions.CargoUnloadMessage
All Implemented Interfaces:
CardActionMessage, GameMessage
public class CargoUnloadMessage extends Object implements CardActionMessage
A message representing a cargo unload action initiated by a player during a card effect handled by a CargoHandlerCard.

This message specifies the cargo to unload based on the tile coordinates on the ship and the index of the container it should be placed into.

When applied, the unloadCargo method of the appropriate card is invoked, executing the logic to remove the cargo block from the ship and transfer it to a container.
